run.executedVia: Playwright runner, no browser: ServiceNow read over cnit and the Scripted REST API as sf.integration, Salesforce read over the sf CLI and anonymous Apex against the deployed classes. Every case reads both sides.

case.title: Drift detection is automatic, repair never is

steps.text: Confirm the LWC only reaches resync from a user gesture.
Confirm nothing in the org runs Sync Health on a schedule.

records.label: Scheduled jobs in the Salesforce org
records.query: sf data query --query "SELECT CronJobDetail.Name, CronJobDetail.JobType, CronExpression, State FROM CronTrigger WHERE State != 'DELETED'" --target-org caf-sf

rows.name: Metalytics Data Loader Job for Org : 00Dak000017K5lc

observations: The three scheduled jobs are Developer Edition org furniture (Program Milestone Computation, Program Status Update, Metalytics Data Loader). None is CAF code and none touches the integration.

Sync Health runs when someone opens the dashboard or presses Re-check. There is no nightly comparison and nothing emails or posts on drift — report as a known limitation, not a defect. HANDOFF open item 5.
expected: No code path repairs without a human pressing Re-sync next to a named difference.
Sync Health has no schedule — a known limitation, HANDOFF open item 5.
actual: Re-sync handlers in the LWC: async handleResync(; bound to onclick in the template: true
3 scheduled job(s) in the org — Program Milestone Computation Cron Job; Program Status Update Cron Job; Metalytics Data Loader Job for Org : 00Dak000017K5lc. 0 of them relate to CAF or to sync.
case.verdictReason: Repair is reachable only from a button next to a named difference, and nothing schedules it. Detection is equally unscheduled — the known limitation this case also records.
